title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I agree with you, but I’m not sure why. If you look at our new hat next to every other hat in baseball, the logo looks the same size as everyone else’s. And yet, they totally look like knockoffs when they are isolated.
I think it’s just the change aspect
I’m not sure it will look so knockoffish next year or maybe even mid season once we get used to it
The whole logo gets bigger, though, like it’s thicker. Inadvertently because it needs to take up more size on hat. Old one just looks more authentic
